patch_description: This implementation replaces covariance cross-entropy search with a deterministic particle-swarm/barrier-feasibility method. A population of full 16-dimensional point configurations maintains personal and global archives, while progressively emphasizing the true minimum triangle determinant and actively repelling configurations with many near-binding triples. Structured triangular-lattice seeds, boundary-support seeds, random simplex seeds, particle velocity updates, periodic particle rejuvenation, and a final active-constraint coordinate refinement are combined. The final stage uses strict lexicographic comparison: raw minimum normalized area first, then the mean of the smallest determinants.
